backtest.note: Unchanged V3 entry rules including partial aggregated bars. Decisions at M5 close; fill next M5 open; TP2 exit; SL first on ambiguous bars; max 72 bars. One alert per directional setup cycle; two closed M5 bars without setup or a direction change rearm alerts. Target path tracked separately after TP2; not additional paper wins. Historical replay is not exact wall-clock live execution.

signal_audit.note: Observed target touches only; excludes the partial candle at alert time. Not fills, not paper wins. Up to 72 M5 bars.

forward_test.execution: Next M5 open after alert; NOT_ENTERED if open beyond SL/TP2. TP2 paper exit; target-path tracking continues separately to TP3/SL/72 bars.
